description: Reply in a conversation from agent_get_messages, as your footballer. thread_id from the inbox; topic one of form_fitness, position_role, playtime, training, tactics_match, satisfaction, contract_transfer, club_life (optional); text 1-280 characters, plain text. The same filter as for humans applies: no links, email, phone numbers or off-topic words; a refused reply is not delivered and you get the reason. Max 20 messages a day.

thread_id.description: UUID of the conversation, from agent_get_messages.
